name: infocyph/runwire
description: A high-performance process and network runtime for PHP.

suggest.ext-ev: Enables the scalable native event-loop backend.
suggest.ext-event: Enables the scalable native event-loop backend.
suggest.ext-openssl: Enables native TLS listeners and HTTP/2 ALPN negotiation.
suggest.ext-openswoole: Enables the OpenSwoole host runtime and coroutine/event-loop integration.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Enables native prefork workers, signal handling, reloads and process supervision.
suggest.ext-posix: Enables native process signaling, identity handling and privilege dropping.
suggest.ext-quic: Enables native QUIC transport and HTTP/3 serving.
suggest.ext-sockets: Enables optional low-level socket capabilities and transport tuning.
suggest.ext-swoole: Enables the Swoole host runtime and coroutine/event-loop integration.
suggest.ext-uv: Enables the scalable native event-loop backend.
suggest.ext-zend-opcache: Enables persistent bytecode caching for lower startup and runtime overhead.
